# Final consolidated results (generated by `src/eval/final_report.py`)

Para-Lane test roads pooled: scene_16, scene_17, scene_14, scene_15, scene_10, scene_3, scene_11, scene_4 (8 held-out roads, never used for training; one design choice, the progressive-update schedule, was also compared on scene_16, RESULTS §6). Images per offset bin (raw splat): 0m: 555, ~3m: 2825, ~6m: 1386; 34 lane-pair sequences. All CIs: 95% bootstrap over lane-pair sequences (clusters of correlated frames), 2,000 resamples.

Every arm, released Difix-ref included, is pooled over all roads.

Figures: `fig1_trust_vs_offset.png`, `fig2_lane_f1_per_road_3m.png`, `fig3_heading_height.png`; qualitative grids `qual_*.jpg` (`src/viz/qualitative.py`).
